results.name: Maschinensatz 8 kW für Flakscheinwerfer 60 cm
results.description:
Maschinensatz 85 Volt, 8 kW – German WWII Generator

This 3D model represents a German WWII Maschinensatz 85 Volt, 8 kW, a portable power generator unit used to operate 60 cm anti-aircraft searchlights (Flakscheinwerfer).

These generator sets were designed to provide stable 85V electrical output required for military searchlight systems. They were typically deployed alongside anti-aircraft units and used for nighttime air defense operations.

The model is based on historical references and available photographic material.

⚠ Disclaimer: This model is not 100% historically accurate. Some proportions, details, and components may differ from the original due to limited reference material.

Optimized for 800,000 polygon target while maintaining visual fidelity.
